name: International Space Station

processing.method: node hierarchy baked; vertex-cluster decimation (grid 128, material+normal-octant keyed); per-vertex colors sampled from the real base-color textures (nearest texel at each vertex UV × baseColorFactor) — derived from the NASA asset, nothing invented

honesty: Decimated derivative of NASA's official ISS model for focused-object display (72–480 px with zoom-to-inspect). Geometry and colors are simplified from the source asset; this is a real model of the real station, not a class-representative form.
